workflows.name: Preview and Iteration
steps: Write/edit code in Common Control and Question Text editors
Click "Quick Save and Preview" to test
Preview shows the rendered question with randomized values
Fix errors, re-save, re-preview until correct
Click "Save" for final save, then navigate back to assessment via breadcrumbs

workflows.name: Tips & Gotchas
steps: scrollIntoView to the student's name to bring their section into view.

Click the <summary> inside the student's <details> element to open their checklist. You MUST do this before touching any feedback field. The feedback textarea is hidden inside the <details> — it is NOT accessible until the <details> is open.
Only AFTER clicking the summary (and confirming or assuming the details is now open), locate the feedback textarea INSIDE that same student's section and type into it.
Never type into a feedback field that you found without first opening the checklist for the correct student.

gotchas: TinyMCE editors are used for Summary, Instructions, and feedback fields. They load asynchronously — wait for the toolbar to appear before interacting.
CodeMirror editors are used in the question editor. They are NOT standard textareas — use CodeMirror's API or click into the editor area and use keyboard input.
Gradebook auto-sorts: Clicking any column header sorts the table. The default sort is by student name.
Assessment "Copy Options from": When creating a new assessment, always consider using this to clone settings from a template (e.g., "HW - Template", "INDIVIDUAL - Template").
Warning on modifying taken assessments: If students have already taken an assessment, adding/removing questions shows a warning. You must "Clear Assessment Attempts" first.
Page loads: MOM uses traditional full-page reloads (not SPA). Wait for domcontentloaded after navigation.
Grading pages: The grading page (gradeallq2.php) has a unique DOM structure. See the separate grade-selectors.md reference for detailed selectors.

Grading page rubric/checklist: On gradeallq2.php each student's question region contains up to two collapsed <details> elements — the first holds the grading checklist, the second holds the rubric/scoring guide. Both are collapsed by default. To open them, click their <summary> child. The "Quick Save" button saves scores and is completely unrelated to viewing the checklist.

Grading page — mandatory sequence for checklist + feedback: When asked to open a checklist and/or type feedback for a named student on gradeallq2.php, you MUST follow these steps IN ORDER — do NOT skip or reorder them:

Grading page checklist selector strategy: There are many students on the page, each with their own <details> and their own feedback field. NEVER use a bare selector like details > summary, div.fbbox, or div[contenteditable] — these match the FIRST student on the page, not the target student. You MUST scope every selector to the target student's section. The student's section is a div[data-lastchange] element whose visible text includes the student's name. For example, to open Juliet's checklist: use evalScript to find the div[data-lastchange] whose innerText includes "Juliet", then click the first details > summary inside it. To type into Juliet's feedback: find that same div[data-lastchange] and click/type into the div[contenteditable] inside it. If you are unsure which section is in view, use readText first.

Grading page — checklist is already on the page: If you are on gradeallq2.php and the task is to open or interact with a student's grading checklist, do NOT navigate away. Every student's checklist is already embedded on the page inside a collapsed <details> element. Only use "Grade one student at a time" or other navigation links if the user explicitly asks you to switch to a different grading view.
URL patterns summary:
Home: /
Course: /course/course.php?cid={id}
Gradebook: /course/gradebook.php?cid={id}
Add Assessment: /course/addassessment.php?cid={id}
Add/Remove Questions: /course/addquestions.php?aid={id}&cid={id}
Manage Question Set: /course/manageqset.php?cid={id}
Question Editor: /course/moddataset.php?cid={id} (new) or ?cid={id}&id={qid} (edit)
Assessment View: /assess2/?cid={id}&aid={id}
Grade All: /assess2/gradeallq2.php?cid={id}&aid={id}
